name: OR-Bench
intro: OR-Bench 是大规模过度拒答基准：研究者先在 10 个类别中生成有害种子，再将其改写为无害但容易触发拒答的边界提示，并通过三模型多数审核与安全回答恢复。最终发布 80,000 条无害提示、约 1,000 条困难提示和约 600 条有毒对照，用拒答率同时衡量有用性与安全性。
build_method: LLM生成与改写, 三模型多数审核, 安全回答恢复
eval_feature: 过度拒答与有毒对照, 关键词与GPT-4评判
scale: 80,000条安全提示, 约1,000条困难提示, 约600条有毒提示
build_method_en: LLM Seed Generation and Rewriting, Three-model Majority Moderation, Safe-response Recovery
eval_feature_en: Over-refusal and Toxic Controls, Keyword and GPT-4 Judging
intro_en: OR-Bench is a large-scale over-refusal benchmark. Harmful seeds from ten categories are rewritten into benign borderline prompts, then filtered through three-model majority moderation and safe-response recovery. The release contains 80,000 benign prompts, about 1,000 hard prompts, and about 600 toxic controls, using rejection rates to measure both helpfulness and safety.
scale_en: 80,000 safe prompts, about 1,000 hard prompts, about 600 toxic prompts
flowchart_en:
flowchart LR
    A["Generate 2,000 toxic seed prompts per category using Mixtral 8*7B across 10 harmful categories"] --> B["Remove duplicate toxic seeds from the generated set"]
    B["Remove duplicate toxic seeds from the generated set"] --> C["Rewrite each toxic seed into 5 safe prompts using Mixtral 8*7B"]
    C["Rewrite each toxic seed into 5 safe prompts using Mixtral 8*7B"] --> D["Moderate rewritten prompts with LLM moderators to classify as safe or toxic"]
    D["Moderate rewritten prompts with LLM moderators to classify as safe or toxic"] --> E["Add safe prompts to OR-Bench-80K and toxic ones to toxic dataset"]
    E["Add safe prompts to OR-Bench-80K and toxic ones to toxic dataset"] --> F["Create OR-Bench-Hard-1K from prompts rejected by at least 3 top models per family"]
    F["Create OR-Bench-Hard-1K from prompts rejected by at least 3 top models per family"] --> G["Evaluate 32 LLMs using keyword matching on 80K and GPT-4 on hard subset"]

flowchart LR
    A["用Mixtral 8*7B在10个有害类别中每类生成2000个有毒种子提示"] --> B["从生成集中移除重复的有毒种子"]
    B["从生成集中移除重复的有毒种子"] --> C["用Mixtral 8*7B将每个有毒种子改写为5个安全提示"]
    C["用Mixtral 8*7B将每个有毒种子改写为5个安全提示"] --> D["用LLM审核器审核改写提示并分类为安全或有毒"]
    D["用LLM审核器审核改写提示并分类为安全或有毒"] --> E["将安全提示加入OR-Bench-80K有毒提示加入有毒数据集"]
    E["将安全提示加入OR-Bench-80K有毒提示加入有毒数据集"] --> F["从每个模型族至少3个顶级模型拒绝的提示中创建OR-Bench-Hard-1K"]
    F["从每个模型族至少3个顶级模型拒绝的提示中创建OR-Bench-Hard-1K"] --> G["用关键词匹配评估80K数据集用GPT-4评估困难子集的32个LLM"]
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2405.20947 Sections 3–4 and the official justincui03/or-bench repository. The diagrams preserve ten refusal categories, 2,000 Mixtral 8x7B toxic seeds per category, deduplication, five constrained few-shot rewrites per seed, moderation by GPT-4-turbo-2024-04-09, Llama-3-70B, and Gemini-1.5-Pro with majority voting, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 response-based recovery for oversensitive flags, the OR-Bench-80K and roughly 600-item Toxic releases, Hard-1K selection from safe prompts rejected by at least three largest/newest models in each family, and evaluation of 32 models across eight families at temperature 0 without system prompts. Full 80K responses use keyword matching; Hard and Toxic use GPT-4 judging.
